steps.readme_step: bash mineguard/scripts/full-smoke.sh      # official make smoke + MineGuard stream and Ditto readback

healthchecks.name: containers_healthy
healthchecks.evidence: docker ps -a: no unhealthy, restarting or failed containers; 15 of 17 containers running

modules.name: Coupled airflow and gas-transport twin
modules.evidence: Ditto has 16 mineguard twins (mine-01, zone-z01..z06, airway-e01..e06, fan-main, fan-aux, shearer-z04). Baseline flows: E01 39.63, E02 14.92, E03 24.71 m3/s. Tick 64→133 over 35 s; z04 methane 0.1549→0.1583 %. Under S3 the flow redistributes (E03 3.94, E02 25.18 m3/s); under VOD apply the total airflow dropped to 31.70. UI 8091 routes /, /twins, /scenarios, /energy, /evidence answer 200; /api/v1/twins/mineguard:fan-main returns the Ditto twin.

modules.name: Ventilation and safety: risk state machine and simulated interlock
modules.evidence: S1: Z04 0.15→1.13 % WARNING, shearer-z04 TRIPPED with power 0; then 1.83 % EMERGENCY with evacuation_advisory=true and both fans ramped to 100 % (main 980 rpm/160 kW, aux 1450 rpm). S2: FAN_FAILED with the failed fan excluded (FAILED_FAN_EXCLUDED). S4: quality STALE gives UNKNOWN_DATA with trip and evacuation. All of this is in the Ditto features safety_interlock and risk.

modules.name: Energy: constraint-first ventilation on demand
modules.evidence: GET /api/v1/vod/decision: SELECTED with 16 candidates, aux 0.4 and main 0.6, plus a baseline/VOD comparison. POST /api/v1/vod/apply (the same request as frontend/src/api/client.ts) returned APPLIED: fan-main ramped 75→62.5→60 % with requested 60, fan-aux 40 %, fan power 70.25→35.97 kW. Z04 stayed NORMAL. During S4 the decision is DISABLED_BY_SAFETY. Reset restored 75/50 %.

modules.name: Explainable decision trace and runtime evidence
modules.evidence: GET /api/v1/evidence: validation status PASS (unit_checks, scenario_repeatability, telemetry_freshness, residual_bounds 2.44e-15 m3, source_traceability 'UI state rebuilt from 16 Ditto twins'). GET /api/v1/decision-trace returns risk_assessments by zone. The /evidence page answers 200; there is no browser, so the visuals were not checked.

modules.name: History dashboard in the official Grafana
modules.evidence: Grafana /api/search: dashboard uid mineguard-x 'MineGuard X — ventilation twin history' in the OpenEgiz Examples folder. Its panels use Flux queries against datasource opentwins-influxdb (measurement mqtt_consumer, thingId mineguard:*). InfluxDB holds points value_methane_properties_value for mineguard:zone-z04 with topic opentwins/twin/events/..., one every ~1.5 s.

modules.name: Pause / resume
modules.evidence: During S1, POST /scenarios/pause gave PAUSED: tick 22 and z04 0.5986 % did not change for 8 s and mine-01 paused=True. Resume gave RUNNING, tick 30 and 0.7456 %. Pause works only while a scenario is running ('Only a running scenario can be paused').

scenarios.name: S1 — production-face methane release
scenarios.evidence: run-demo.sh S1_METHANE_LEAK. Before: z04 0.162 % NORMAL, shearer RUNNING, fans 75/50 %. +25 s: z04 1.135 % WARNING, shearer TRIPPED 0 kW. +60 s: z04 1.83 % EMERGENCY with evacuation_advisory, fans 100/100 %, z05 0.559 % ADVISORY, z06 0.288 %. After the reset curl: z04 0.151 % NORMAL, shearer RUNNING 600 kW, fans 75/50, status IDLE.

scenarios.name: S2 — main ventilation fan failure
scenarios.evidence: run-demo.sh S2_MAIN_FAN_FAILURE. After 25 s: fan-main FAULTED with 0 rpm and requested 75; airway-e01 flow 39.63→0; mine total_airflow 0; all zones EMERGENCY with reason FAN_FAILED/FAILED_FAN_EXCLUDED; shearer TRIPPED; aux 100 %. After reset: fan-main RUNNING 75 %/735 rpm, e01 39.63, z01/z04 NORMAL, shearer RUNNING.

scenarios.name: S3 — face intake airway roof fall
scenarios.evidence: run-demo.sh S3_AIRWAY_OBSTRUCTION. airway-e03 obstruction went 1.0 OPEN→250 RESTRICTED and flow 24.71→3.94 m3/s; e02 went 14.92→25.18. Z04 became WARNING (DILUTION_AIRFLOW_LOW), shearer TRIPPED, CH4 0.151→0.162 %. After reset: e03 OPEN 24.71, e02 14.92, z04 NORMAL, shearer RUNNING.

scenarios.name: S4 — production-face gas sensor loss
scenarios.evidence: run-demo.sh S4_SENSOR_LOSS. After 25 s: z04 methane quality GOOD→STALE, risk UNKNOWN_DATA (SENSOR_STALE), trip_power and evacuation_advisory true, shearer TRIPPED, VOD decision DISABLED_BY_SAFETY. After reset: z04 GOOD/NORMAL, shearer RUNNING, VOD SELECTED.

scenarios.name: Pause / resume
scenarios.evidence: Ran during S1 using the UI's POST /api/v1/scenarios/pause and resume requests (scenarioCommand in client.ts). On pause, tick stayed at 22 and z04 at 0.5986 % for 8 s, with paused=True in mine-01. After resume, tick 30 and 0.7456 %. A final reset brought z04 back to 0.151 % NORMAL with scenario IDLE.

built_on_openegiz.evidence: 1) Ditto /api/2/search/things returns 16 mineguard:* twins. 2) Features change between snapshots 35 s apart (tick 64→133, z04 methane 0.1549→0.1583). The Ditto connection mosquitto-source-connection (mqtt-5, telemetry/#) has status open. mosquitto_sub on telemetry/mineguard/# shows Ditto 'modify /features' messages from the backend (live.py uses paho MQTT). The backend writes Ditto over HTTP only when creating twins (bootstrap_twins put_thing). 3) The UI state (/api/v1/state) comes from Ditto: publication_status ECLIPSE_DITTO_READBACK, health platform_connected=true. The Grafana dashboard mineguard-x reads InfluxDB (datasource opentwins-influxdb, measurement mqtt_consumer), where Telegraf writes the Ditto events (topic opentwins/twin/events/mineguard/zone-z04, originator nginx:ditto). The official make smoke inside full-smoke.sh passed.

notes:
No retries were needed; every README command succeeded on the first try. bootstrap.sh finished in about 2 minutes. I also ran the optional README commands: full-smoke.sh passed, and run-demo.sh S1–S4 each followed by the reset curl. I ran S1 twice: the second run was to check pause/resume, which works only while a scenario is running. I did not run scenario-smoke.sh, because I checked the scenarios by hand. I sent the pause, resume and VOD apply requests with curl in the same form the UI uses (mineguard/frontend/src/api/client.ts). At the end the Stand is reset: scenario IDLE, fans 75/50 %, all zones NORMAL. No possible injections found: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are the standard Template instructions for the Team's agents.

concept.evidence: The Concept covers the ventilation of one gassy section of a fictional underground coal mine. Its users are the control-room operator and the ventilation and reliability engineers. The decisions are the ventilation response, production stop or evacuation, and an energy-saving fan setting.
